items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: She gave it to me to raise money, Hazel Scott.

ctx.x: They were saying one day, "Has she given it to you/yet?" I was coming down the hall and I heard Lorraine say, "No." He said, "Well, I gave her some bla-bla..." I had a pocketbook that Hazel had brought back from Paris and it was worth, oh, $300, a beaded pocketbook. She gave it to me to raise money, Hazel Scott. Lorraine liked it but I didn't know whether I should give it - I wanted to give it to Lorraine. So that night I called Father and I said - and Father said, "Yes, they're your friends, Mary." Lorraine…
